|--------|--------|-------|
| L0→L1 wiring | Statically pre-wired at init using a double-size concatenated L1 table and a loop in `mmu_init_pagetables` | Fully lazy/dynamic: `mmu_pt_get_l1()` allocates L1 tables on demand |
| L1 blocks (4K only) | Not supported | New `mmu_pt_map_l1()` + `mmu_pt_get_l1()` for 4K L1-block mappings |
| `mmu_map` logic | Linear L3→L2 only | Conditional `!is_16k()` branch adds L2→L1 alignment phase |
| `VADDR_L1_INDEX_BITS` | Had `_ACTUAL` split for concatenated trick | Collapsed to single `VADDR_L1_INDEX_BITS` (11 or 9 depending on page size) |
| `VADDR_L0_OFFSET_BITS` | Absent | Added (`47` for 16K, `39` for 4K) |
| Block macros removed | `L1_IS_BLOCK`, `L2_IS_BLOCK`, `L3_IS_BLOCK` | Removed — callers now test `PTE_TYPE` directly or inline |
| `mmu_make_table_pte` | Existed as static helper | Removed entirely; folded into callers |
| Static `mmu_pt_L1` pointer | Global | Removed — L1 tables are now heap-allocated per L0 entry |
| `mmu_pt_get_l2` | Assumed block-empty L1 | Now promotes a pre-existing L1 block into an L2 table (split-down path) |
